title: Meringue
hook: Egg whites and sugar. *More sugar*, a new meringue.
cover_text: Same egg whites, *more sugar*, a crisp meringue

dishes.name: Soft meringue
dishes.text: *Equal weights*: a soft, glossy foam to swirl on a lemon pie.

dishes.name: Meringue kisses
dishes.text: *Up to twice the sugar*: a stiff foam that bakes dry and crisp.

sheet_text: Less sugar stays *soft*, more sugar dries crisp.
sources: https://app.ckbk.com/reference/food00011c02s001e007se006se001/sugar-in-meringues (McGee: sugar to white ranges from about 1:1 to 2:1 by weight)
https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Cookbook:Meringue (soft meringue equal parts by weight; hard up to 2 parts sugar to 1 white)
https://bakerbettie.com/how-to-make-easy-meringue/ (lowest sugar ratio typically 1:1 white:sugar by weight)
https://www.kingarthurbaking.com/recipes/meringues-recipe (crisp meringues ≈ 418 g sugar to 198–227 g whites, about 2:1)
